relations.reading: Event-triggered promotion can be compared retrospectively with relabeling cascades, provided event identity and the times of capture, knowledge and reinterpretation remain distinct.

relations.title: Traducción de captura a arquitectura
relations.reading: Operational tracking could retain permitted unresolved traces before lossy admission, so that later qualification can revisit evidence that actually exists.

relations.title: Validez histórica y validez al uso
relations.reading: The dual-time contract makes a later implementation obligation explicit: historical reinterpretation and current permission to rely on a certificate must be evaluated separately.
